S1 unit 1 is built and committed on v2/s1: Profile, Settings, Sign in, the phone approval page, the parent/tutor share view, Help and the diagnostic sign-up gate. All pages load at 1280 and 390 with no sideways scroll and no console errors, for a seeded learner and a brand-new one. Nothing was pushed. The branch is detached and the server is stopped.

**Checks**
- `server/checks/s1.py` passed.
- `server/test_flow.py` stops at the known date-dependent failure in `server/checks/s8.py` (~line 519, `compete.contest` 404). This run never hit the s3.py failure.
- Phone approval works end to end in a real browser: a new browser signs in by phone and adds its 50 answers when you pick "Add them" (the account went from 50 to 100).
- Port 8021 is held by a launchd socket, so I ran the server on **18021** instead.

**What each page does**
- **Profile (`/me/`)**: the 16 cards on the section bar, each loading and retrying on its own. Two columns from 1024px, one column in the phone order below that, and a fold on every card that survives a reload. Shared helpers are in `web/me/account.js` and the weekly-goals sheet in `web/me/week.js` (`UI.week`). With `window.ME_SHARE` set, the same file draws the read-only share view.
- **Settings (`/me/settings/`)**: every pref key has a row in one of the six sections, plus boards, the email code flow, passkeys, devices, family device, transfer codes, reports, share links, export and delete.
- **Sign in (`/signin/`)**: Passkey · Use your phone · Email code · More. It opens on the method this browser used last, the shared-computer box applies to every tab, the passkey autofill request renews before its challenge expires, and every path ends in the carry choice.
- **Phone approval**: the phone's side is at `/pair/?c=…`, and the QR on the other device points there.
- **Help (`/help/`)**: built from `web/help/answers.json` (48 answers), which the palette's Help group now finds.
- **Diagnostic gate**: a saved learner skips the form. Everyone else fills it in, and the page opens the results once the email link is tapped.

**Choices I made**
- Following your 2026-09-28 rules, I dropped the identity card's goal pills, the Score trend header numbers and the heatmap's streak and study-time totals, because other cards already show them.
- I hid the shared kit's "rough" badge and its duplicate "no answers yet" line, and scores read "7 / 10".
- The share view has no shell or nav, as its spec says, which breaks the "every page mounts the shell" rule.
- `server/cache/` is left untracked. It is a server-generated cache, not work.

**Server fixes needed (helper)**
- The shell's `inbox` comes back as an object, and the phone avatar badge shows "NaN". It should be the unread count (`account.shell_part`).
- `/api/health` is missing `mail`, `google` and the Google client ID. Until those exist the Google button stays hidden, and the email-off message only appears after a send.
- Missing endpoints:
  - an "End the old code now" endpoint;
  - estimating what an arbitrary target needs (for the live target slider);
  - `/api/push/*`, so "Notify me" is not shown;
  - `/api/mistakes/import`, for "Bring your misses".
- Missing fields in `/api/me/summary`:
  - `subjects.math.pace`: the Pace card only shows its empty state until this lands;
  - `score.projection` and `score.gaps`;
  - check-ins passed and due;
  - week history;
  - `skills[].last`;
  - the student's default board name.
- `/api/shared/{token}` needs the name and the activity days: until then the heading reads "SAT progress" and the heatmap is hidden.
- `PUT /api/me` refuses `avatar: 'initial'`, so the picker has no Initial tile.
- Feed fixes:
  - achievement rows read "Hard Right · Tier 10" instead of the badge name;
  - scores come as "7 of 10 right";
  - report links use `?s=` where the report page reads `?id=`;
  - the effect counts repeat identically across sittings.
- Lever texts show raw skill ids, e.g. "Practise nonlinear_functions".

**Needed from other owners**
- **F2 (`ui.js`, `palette.js`)**:
  - "Sign in another device" links to `/link/`, which doesn't exist. The brief gives S1 `web/link/**`, but this run's ownership list didn't, so I didn't create it. Either add a redirect to `/pair/` or change those three links.
  - `UI.signOut` checks `me.linked`, so a passkey-only saved learner gets the unsaved "Leave this device" dialog.
  - The first-visit "Sign in" banner shows on `/signin/` itself.
  - The automatic weekly sheet needs to load `/me/week.js` and call `UI.week()`.
- **F1 (`kit.js`)**: `UI.skillRow` still prints "rough" and a duplicate "no answers yet" for other pages.
- **F5**: the readiness atlas can't sort types by weight, because the question-type list the shell loads (`/api/shell/catalog`) has no weight.

S1 unit 2 of 2 is finished. Everything is committed on `v2/s1`, and the branch is detached so it's free again. The final headless walk loaded 9 pages × new and seeded learner × 1280 and 390, 36 loads in all. None had horizontal scroll or a JS error. The only console error is the expected 404 when a share link has been turned off (`/share/?t=nope`).

Checks:
- **`server/checks/s1.py`:** prints "S1 checks passed".
- **`server/test_flow.py`:** does not reach "all good". It stops at the known date-dependent failure in `server/checks/s8.py` ~line 519 (`compete.contest` 404, helper Task 30); I didn't touch it.

**Port:** I used 8121 for the dev server, because launchd holds 8021 on this machine. The server is stopped and I deleted the runtime `server/cache/`.

## Commits (on top of unit 1's)
- `5fc2c8a` **Me:**
  - a "?" on each figure's card opens that Help answer, via `UI.acct.helpBtn`, read from `answers.json`.
  - Skills offers "Sharpen · 12 questions · ~19 min" when some skills have under 10 answers, worded without "rough".
  - Recent-activity rows get a chevron, achievement rows read "Earned: …", and older links like `#achievements` open their card.
  - Identity lines now sit under the avatar row, skill rows fit the narrow column, and 6-digit code boxes are visible on a card (this was broken on `/pair/`).
  - The photo picker adds "Take one" (front camera) on phones.
  - `UI.acct.googleButton` added.
- `0ddb123` **Settings:**
  - A "Notify me on this device" row with its three kinds, one "Want a nudge at 19:00?" offer, and permission asked only on a tap.
  - A line saying the chosen reminder still rings when the study time falls inside quiet hours.
  - A Google block (Save with Google, or the connected line with Disconnect).
  - A "?" on each section. Sign in now uses the shared Google button.
- `3f0cb2a` **Question-type sheet (Me):**
  - It draws its example with the shared question renderer: no answer key, not answerable, math and figures shown properly.
  - A stray "null" is gone.
  - Share links no longer show the student-facing "what your target takes" line.
  - A new student no longer sees "Not started" 19 times.
- `76b43e1` **Week history and Climb:** This week shows the last six weeks (once the server sends it), and Climb reads "Started 440–600 · +90 · ahead of 74% of 212".
- `f787535` **Held-back popovers:** the band, points and readiness "how it's worked out" popovers are held back. They showed `[object Object]`, a raw topic slug, and 255 types met under a 10% figure. Those figures are plain text until the server copy is fixed.
- `1a2c9e5` **Target popover:** shows live what the target takes ("At least 14 of 22 right in module 1…") and the pace to the exam, from Plan's own preview.

Verified headlessly:
- A "?" and a stat tile both open on Enter, and Esc returns focus to them.
- A folded card stays folded after a reload, and heatmap arrow keys move.
- All 12 sheets and popovers stay on screen at 390.
- A failing summary or feed shows Retry only in its own cards; offline shows the banner; a signed-out device shows the retired banner and hides the cards.

## Needed from other owners
- **Helper (server):**
  - `/api/health` should add `mail`, `google`, `google_client_id` and `push` (Settings reads them; the push row only shows when `push` is true).
  - Push is not built yet. I built the page against `GET /api/push/key` plus `POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE /api/push/subscribe {endpoint, keys?, kinds}`; those endpoint names are my choice, so the helper should build them or tell me others.
  - `/api/account` needs a `google {email_masked, since}` field, and `DELETE /api/google` for Disconnect.
  - `/api/shared` needs `name`, `updated`, `days` and `week`. Without them the share view's H1 reads "SAT progress" and its heatmap is hidden.
  - `/api/me/week` needs `history: [{week, start, met, total}]`.
  - `summary.subjects.math.pace` and `score.projection` are missing, so the Pace card shows only its empty state and the trend shows no projection line.
  - The lever copy needs fixing: band returns an object, the points lever's next step uses a topic slug, and readiness returns the met count. Once fixed, remove the key from `HELD` in `web/me/me.js`.
  - A Compete badge named "Level five" breaks your no-levels rule.
- **F1 (`kit.js`):**
  - The `leverParts` popover should format `{low, high}` and word-type values.
  - `UI.skillRow` prints "rough · N answers" whenever it is given `evidence`.
  - The code-box background rule `.card .otp input` loses to `.otp input`; I patched it only on my pages.
  - The `skill:<topic>` popover shows a raw 0.638. Once it shows the mastery word, I can make the mastery bars open it.
- **F2:**
  - The user card and phone avatar show a "NaN" badge on every page.
  - `/sw.js` doesn't exist yet, so push can't turn on even once the server lands.
  - `UI.quick('mistake', {template})` would let "Log a mistake on it" arrive with that question type already picked.
  - `UI.help` and `UI.fracText` don't exist yet (Me falls back to its own "?" popover and the question renderer).
  - The spec's `/link/?r=` URL isn't a page; the QR points to `/pair/?r=`.

Not done: I didn't add page-level keyboard shortcuts on Me or Help, because the spec names none.
